tools.name: add_followup
tools.description: Track something someone owes the user: a reply, a document, a payment. due defaults to a week from today.

tools.name: list_followups
tools.description: Open follow-ups, most overdue first. Overdue unpaid invoices are pulled in automatically.

tools.name: mark_followup
tools.description: Set a follow-up's status: open, sent (reminder went out), done.

tools.name: draft_reminders
tools.description: Draft a reminder message for every overdue follow-up (tone: polite | friendly | firm; sign_as: the user's name). The user copies and sends them; nothing is sent automatically.
